The state of Duma calls the condition that Pugachev will be deprived of the title of People's Artist
According to the law, the award of singer Alla Pugacheva, gained during the Soviet Union, could be canceled, however, appropriate decisions and court. This was announced by the first Vice President of the State Duma for Alexander Sholokhov culture.
Yes, this is possible, this is clearly provided, but only when a person belongs to the action of the Criminal Code for the commission of serious and particularly serious crimes. According to the Court's decision, he could be deprived of the Soviet award.
It is known what the property could lose Pugachev in Russia
Deputy also noted the importance of a public reaction to such cases. According to him, the signature collection reflects the position of society and can affect the opinions of those who are still suspicious. Sholokhov emphasized that society should show his position related to public people, especially when it comes to those who are separated from the country. Politician added that from the moral point of view, he considered Pugachev as an old Russian citizen.
Earlier, the head of the Federal Safety and Anti -Corruption Project, Vitaly Borodin, initiated the signature collection for the title of singer Alla Pugacheva, the title of People's Artist, RT report. According to social activist, in a recent interview with journalist Katerina Gordeva (recognized by the Ministry of Justice of the Russian Federation, Ino -agent) Pugacheva justified terrorist acts and expressed support for Johar Dudaev, according to him.
